# dist/

This directory contains build artifacts generated by the Ohnrscript LLVM IR pipeline.
Do not edit these files manually.

## Contents (after build)

- `ohn-vector-native.ll` — LLVM IR text file emitted by the Ohnrscript LLVM generator
- `ohn-vector-native` — Native binary (ARM64 or x86-64) compiled by clang -O3 -march=native

## Build

```bash
# From repo root:
node compiler/src/run-llvm.js \
    packages-llvm/ohn-vector-native/src/ohn-vector-native.ohn \
    packages-llvm/ohn-vector-native/dist/ohn-vector-native.ll

clang -O3 -march=native \
    packages-llvm/ohn-vector-native/dist/ohn-vector-native.ll \
    compiler/src/shim/ohnrscript-runtime.c \
    compiler/src/shim/bench-harness.c \
    -o packages-llvm/ohn-vector-native/dist/ohn-vector-native -lm
```

## Verification

```bash
# Verify IR is valid LLVM
llvm-as packages-llvm/ohn-vector-native/dist/ohn-vector-native.ll -o /dev/null

# Verify zero unsupported constructs
grep '; UNSUPPORTED' packages-llvm/ohn-vector-native/dist/ohn-vector-native.ll
# Expected: (no output)
```
